name: browser-knowledge
description: Your Rain knowledge base in Claude: notes, pages, docs, connections and what you're working on now. Proof of concept.
long_description: Reads the knowledge base Rain app keeps on your Mac: Markdown notes in your notes folders, pages you read, Chrome history, Google Docs and Notion pages, your spaces and folders, and what you have open right now. The index stays on your Mac. What an AI client reads from it goes to that client's AI provider. Choose what AI clients can see in the app's Settings, under AI clients. This is a proof of concept, not a finished product.

app_path.title: Rain app
app_path.description: Path to Rain.app. Leave empty to find it automatically.

data_dir.title: Profile folder
data_dir.description: Only for a separate profile started with --data-dir. Leave empty for your normal profile.
